author: wylt
body:
Hi everyone I guess it's time to introduce myself since I will be playing on here a lot more often. I'm wylt, or you can call me Ryan. I joined this server almost  2 years ago with a few friends from the Overcast Network. Since OCN is now fully 1.9, I still want to play something like old OCN, so I'll start playing Avicus a lot. I played the Race for Victory tournament with Power Puff Boys/EC, and we won it. I also have seen some pretty good players that I've seen before on OCN (Zegita,Loo,etc). But yeah, I'll look forward to seeing some of you in the future.













also ginie is sexy af
